notes: Each contender is one config the runner will install on the SAME AIOStreams instance with the SAME debrid credentials.
'source: local' = a JSON template in this repo. 'source: url' = a published community template fetched at run time.
'lane' selects which debrid service block the runner enables + injects the key into (from the gitignored env file).
'variant_of' + 'single_variable' mark Phase-1(c) experimental variants: exactly ONE attributable change vs the named control.
Do NOT add a contender without a citation (for challengers) or a repo path (for control/variants).

Tests H2 directly. filterer.ts coerces a missing resolution to the literal 'Unknown' and drops the stream unless 'Unknown' is allowlisted, so Apex currently discards every stream whose resolution the parser cannot determine. The same templates already allowlist 'Unknown' in requiredLanguages. Measures what that asymmetry costs in coverage, and what junk it lets back in.
